# IssueTypeIcon

<!-- description:start -->
Displays the icon for a Tracker issue type (task, bug, epic, improvement, etc.). Each issue type maps to a distinct SVG asset. Unknown type keys fall back to a generic icon.
<!-- description:end -->

## Usage

```tsx
import {IssueTypeIcon} from '@weavix/tracker-components';

<IssueTypeIcon issueType="bug" />
```

## Component props

<!-- props:start -->
```ts
{
    /**
     * Issue type key. Known values are listed below; any other string is
     * accepted and falls back to a generic icon.
     */
    issueType:
        | 'task'
        | 'bug'
        | 'design'
        | 'epic'
        | 'improvement'
        | 'incident'
        | 'info'
        | 'milestone'
        | 'newFeature'
        | 'query'
        | 'refactoring'
        | 'release'
        | 'research'
        | 'serviceRequest'
        | 'story'
        | 'subBug'
        | 'subTask'
        | 'technicalDebt'
        | string;

    /**
     * Size of the icon in pixels.
     * @default 16
     */
    size?: number;

    /**
     * Additional CSS class applied to the root element.
     */
    className?: string;

    /**
     * Additional CSS class applied to the outer container element.
     */
    containerClassName?: string;

    /**
     * Human-readable display name for the issue type (e.g. `"Bug"`, `"Story"`).
     * When provided, an accessible label `"Type: <issueType>"` is rendered for
     * screen readers and `title` is forwarded to the icon container.
     * When omitted, the icon is treated as decorative (`aria-hidden`).
     */
    title?: string;
}
```
<!-- props:end -->

---

## Examples

### Single icon

```tsx
import {IssueTypeIcon} from '@weavix/tracker-components';

<IssueTypeIcon issueType="task" />
<IssueTypeIcon issueType="bug" />
<IssueTypeIcon issueType="epic" />
```

### Custom size

```tsx
<IssueTypeIcon issueType="story" size={24} />
<IssueTypeIcon issueType="story" size={32} />
```

### Alongside issue summary

```tsx
import {IssueTypeIcon} from '@weavix/tracker-components';

export const IssueRow = ({issue}: {issue: {type: string; summary: string}}) => (
    <div style={{display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8}}>
        <IssueTypeIcon issueType={issue.type} size={16} />
        <span>{issue.summary}</span>
    </div>
);
```

### All known issue types

```tsx
import {IssueTypeIcon} from '@weavix/tracker-components';

const ISSUE_TYPES = [
    'task', 'bug', 'design', 'epic', 'improvement',
    'incident', 'info', 'milestone', 'newFeature', 'query',
    'refactoring', 'release', 'research', 'serviceRequest',
    'story', 'subBug', 'subTask', 'technicalDebt',
] as const;

export const IssueTypeGallery = () => (
    <div style={{display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 16}}>
        {ISSUE_TYPES.map((type) => (
            <div key={type} style={{display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4}}>
                <IssueTypeIcon issueType={type} size={24} />
                <span style={{fontSize: 11}}>{type}</span>
            </div>
        ))}
    </div>
);
```

### From Tracker API

Requires the `"tracker:issuetypes:read"` permission in your plugin's `manifest.json`:

```json
{
    "permissions": {
        "data": ["tracker:issuetypes:read"]
    }
}
```

```tsx
import {IssueTypeIcon} from '@weavix/tracker-components';

const issueType = await trackerApi.v3.get['/issues/{id}/{field}']({
    pathParams: {
        id: 'ISSUEKEY-1',
        field: 'type',
    },
});

<IssueTypeIcon
    issueType={issueType.data.key}
    title={issueType.data.display}
/>
```

---

## Notes

- The `issueType` value is matched case-sensitively against the known keys. Values returned by the Tracker API (e.g. `"newFeature"`, `"subTask"`) match directly without transformation.
- Passing an unknown string does not throw — the component renders a generic fallback icon.
- When `title` is omitted the icon is treated as decorative and gets `aria-hidden="true"`. Pass `title` (e.g. `type.display` from the API) to make the icon accessible.
